items.text: Said the earlier version of that budget law should not advance until its work requirements and spending reductions took effect sooner.
Said party colleagues should let the expanded premium subsidies expire, and should not expect support for any deal that extends them.

After the committee vote, said the budget bill needed further changes before final passage, including an end to the financing arrangements that let regional governments draw additional national funds for public health coverage.

Said they would introduce a bill to phase down over eight years the higher national funding share for adults added to low-income public health coverage until it equals the regular share, and to let regional governments narrow eligibility for that group.

Said colleagues should lower the national funding share for adults added to low-income public health coverage to the regular share, limit the financing arrangements regional governments use to draw national funds, and rule out further expansion of that coverage.
